A.strength: Fully CSS-drawn staged-room surfaces and literal placeholders everywhere make it the strictest reading of the output contract, with sticky editorial layouts.
A.weakness: Bracket placeholders in the tier cards and filler agent-feature copy leave conversion paths thin, and CTAs dead-end in anchor loops.

B.strength: Richest, most persuasive dual-audience copy and the most polished slider and count-up interactions.
B.weakness: Invents beyond the brief — a 'Most Requested' flag, named past projects, a 68px H1 over the 56px ceiling, a displaced sub anchor, and off-palette blue-gray tiles.

C.strength: Anchor-exact type system (14px/1.5px uppercase CTAs, verbatim H1 and sub) with warm in-palette placeholder surfaces and honest placeholder framing throughout.
C.weakness: The testimonial runs small for a 'large' Playfair quote and the layout is safer and less inventive than A's art direction.

notes: C edges A on spec fidelity and color discipline; A leads on art direction but starves conversion copy; B is the handsomest in motion yet loosest with the brief's facts and type ceilings.
